name: A Donation of Silk

angles.text: As a mage, your own craft depends on these stores of cloth, making every bundle directly serve your fellow practitioners.
Tailors know the worth of woven cloth, and your bolts can directly replenish the dwindling supplies of the order.

faq.answer: The order has depleted its stores while properly outfitting its mages with equipment. Sixty pieces of cloth help restore what was spent.
faq.q: Why does the order need silk?

faq.answer: The order asks for sixty pieces of silk cloth to replenish its supplies.

aliases: what do i get for silk
faq.answer: Providing the cloth raises your standing and favor with the order.
faq.q: What do you gain by donating silk?

faq.answer: A representative of the magical order gathers the cloth to support and equip their spellcasters.

sections.body: Equipping mages across the order has emptied the storehouses of cloth. Sixty pieces of woven fabric will restore the reserve and earn you genuine goodwill among the spellcasters.
sections.title: Replenishing the Bolt

summary: Outfitting practicing mages has completely exhausted the order's stores of silk cloth. Supplying sixty pieces helps replenish their reserves and raises your standing in their eyes.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Silk
